verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is documented as an iOS/Android in-person selling app, and nothing in the evidence shows it running headlessly or in CI. The Shopify CLI for scaffolding UI extensions and extension access to the GraphQL Admin API are developer building blocks for in-app customization, not a headless or CI execution mode for POS. Because headless automation is a fair question for this kind of software but no direct capability is documented, the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
